annotations.examples: array; never validated as input defaults
annotations.title: string

compatibility: Existing entry points select native-compat/v1 before parsing and retain their current format/number/input semantics; shared source and registry are reused. They never retry after a portable validation failure. A changed legacy acceptance set requires an explicit new version and approval.

limits_for_new_portable_facade.decoded_byte_encoding: RFC8785 canonical UTF-8; raw incoming UTF-8 has the same independent byte cap.
limits_for_new_portable_facade.depth_definition: Every JSON value counts, including a scalar or empty container; root depth is 1.
limits_for_new_portable_facade.numeric_model: finite IEEE-754 binary64; exact integers only through 2^53-1; money and identifiers are strings

references: closed registered resource ids and JSON pointers only; reject missing, external, recursive and dynamic references; never retrieve network/file URIs
